plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Comtrol RocketLinx switch. It reports uptime, temperature, optical modules, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 2882).
name: Switch

metrics.name: sfp_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Current SFP DDM temperature in degrees Celsius from portSfpDdmTempatureCurrent on the es8520-xt portSfpTable branch. DisplayString text is parsed to a number (unit suffix such as C is stripped). Empty, N/A or no-module rows are skipped. Abnormally high module temperature can indicate airflow issues or a failing optic.

metrics.name: sfp_tx_power
metrics.description: Current SFP DDM transmit power from portSfpDdmTxPowerCurrent on the es8520-xt portSfpTable branch. DisplayString text is parsed to a number (unit suffix such as dBm is stripped). Empty, N/A or no-module rows are skipped. Abnormally low Tx power can indicate an aging or failing optical module.

metrics.name: sfp_rx_power
metrics.description: Current SFP DDM receive power from portSfpDdmRxPowerCurrent on the es8520-xt portSfpTable branch. DisplayString text is parsed to a number (unit suffix such as dBm is stripped). Empty, N/A or no-module rows are skipped. Abnormally low Rx power can indicate link attenuation, dirty fiber, or a faulty peer transmitter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
